Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.text: Ramesh says he is a painter and that Sunita had messaged him.
Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol rah.quote: Hello, Sunita madam? Main Ramesh bol raha hoon, painter. Aapne message kiya tha.

Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.text: Sunita says the flat needs painting.
Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.quote: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.text: Sunita says Ramesh had gone to see the flat yesterday.
Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karw.quote: Haan Ramesh ji, namaste. Flat paint karwana hai. Aap kal dekh ke gaye the na?

Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.text: Ramesh says the job is a 2BHK flat, with both rooms, the hall, the kitchen, and the bathroom doors to be done.
Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.value: 2BHK flat; both rooms, hall, kitchen, and bathroom doors
Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kam.quote: Ji madam, dekh liya. 2BHK hai - dono kamre, hall, kitchen. Bathroom ke darwaze bhi karne hain na?

Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.text: Sunita says the job also includes the balcony railing, with two coats on the walls and one coat on the ceiling.
Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.value: balcony railing; two coats on walls; one coat on ceiling
Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing.quote: Haan darwaze bhi, aur balcony ki railing bhi. Walls pe do coat chahiye, ceiling pe ek chalega.

Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.text: Ramesh says the walls will have two coats, the ceiling one coat, the doors and railing will get enamel, and putty will be done wherever needed.
Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.value: walls two coats, ceiling one coat, doors and railing enamel, putty where needed
Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek.quote: Theek hai ji. Walls do coat, ceiling ek coat, darwaze aur railing pe enamel. Putty jahan zaroorat ho wahan kar dunga.

Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.text: Sunita says she will bring the paint herself and asks Ramesh to quote only the labour.
Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki.quote: Paint main khud le aaungi, mere bhai ki dukaan hai. Aap sirf labour ka batao.

Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.text: The worker says the material will be provided by the hirer.
The worker says the labour-only price will be 15,000 rupees.
Achha, material aapka. To sirf labour ka.quote: To sirf labour ka madam... 15 hazaar lagega.

15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.text: Sunita says 15,000 rupees is too much and implies a lower labour-only price should be considered.
15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi t.quote: 15 zyada hai Ramesh ji. Sirf labour hi to hai.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh says three workers will be needed.
Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.quote: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai. Chaliye 14 kar dete hain.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh says the job will take six days.
Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.quote: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai. Chaliye 14 kar dete hain.

Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.text: Ramesh offers to do the job for 14,000 rupees.
Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka ka.quote: Madam teen aadmi lagenge, chhe din ka kaam hai. Chaliye 14 kar dete hain.

12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..text: Sunita offers 12,000 rupees for the total labour price.
12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon..quote: 12 mein karo to abhi pakka karti hoon.

12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.text: Ramesh offers 13,000 rupees as the last price and says he will not go below that.
12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, l.quote: 12 mein nahi padta madam... 13 hazaar, last. Isse neeche nahi.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.text: Sunita accepts 13,000 rupees as the amount.
Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.text: Sunita says the work is labour only and the material is hers.
Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, mater.quote: Theek hai, 13 hazaar. Sirf labour, material mera.

3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.text: Ramesh asks for an advance of 3,000 rupees and says it is needed to pay the workers.
3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena.quote: 3 hazaar de dijiye madam, ladkon ko dena padta hai.

Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.text: Sunita accepts Ramesh's advance of 3,000 rupees and says she will give it tomorrow morning in cash.
Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi,.quote: Theek hai, 3 hazaar kal subah de dungi, cash mein.

Ji. Aur baaki?.text: Ramesh asks what about the बाकी payment.

Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.text: Sunita says the remaining payment will be made after the work is fully completed, on the day it is finished, after she checks the work first.
Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.value: remaining payment after completion and inspection
Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din f.quote: Baaki kaam poora hone ke baad, jis din finish karoge usi din. Pehle main kaam dekhungi, phir payment.

Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.text: Ramesh says the remaining payment is 11,000 rupees, after a 3,000 rupee advance from a total of 14,000 rupees, and it is due on finishing after the work is seen.
Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. T.quote: Theek hai madam, kaam dekh ke hi dena. To total 14 hazaar mein se 3 advance, baaki finish hone pe.

Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se.text: Sunita asks when Ramesh will start.
Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se.quote: Haan haan theek hai. Achha, shuru kab se karoge?

Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron s.text: Ramesh says the work will start the day after tomorrow, Wednesday.
Ramesh asks Sunita to remove the items from the rooms tomorrow.
Parson se madam, Wednesday. Kal kamron s.quote: Kal kamron se saamaan hata lijiyega.

Aur khatam kab hoga?.text: Sunita asks when the work will be finished.

Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.text: The worker says the job will take six days and be finished by next Monday.
Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho.quote: Chhe din lagenge ji, agle Monday tak ho jayega.

Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office.text: Sunita says it needs to be definitely finished by Monday because she has office from Tuesday and nobody will be home after that.
Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office.quote: Monday tak pakka? Tuesday se mera office hai, uske baad ghar pe koi nahi hoga.

Pakka madam, Monday shaam tak..text: The worker says it will be finished by Monday evening.

Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.text: Sunita asks what happens if the work is left in the middle and the worker leaves.
Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale.quote: Aur agar beech mein kaam chhod ke chale gaye to? Aajkal bahut hota hai ye.

Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam.text: Ramesh says that if he leaves the work unfinished, Sunita should not pay the remaining money and he will return the advance.
Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam.value: if unfinished, no remaining payment and advance returned
Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam.quote: Nahi madam, aisa nahi karunga. Agar kaam adhoora chhoda to baaki paise mat dena, aur advance bhi wapas kar dunga.

Theek hai. Aur late hua to?.text: Sunita says that if the work is late, the remaining payment should not be given and the advance should be returned.
Theek hai. Aur late hua to?.value: no balance and advance returned if late/unfinished
Theek hai. Aur late hua to?.quote: Theek hai. Aur late hua to?

Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena.text: Ramesh says that if the work is late, Sunita should deduct 300 rupees per day.
Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena.quote: Late hua to roz ka 300 rupaye kaat lena madam.

Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa j.text: Sunita accepts Wednesday morning, 10 o'clock as the start time.
Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa j.quote: Chalo theek hai. To Wednesday subah aa jao, 10 baje.

Ji madam, Wednesday 10 baje. Paint tab t.text: The worker says the paint should be arranged by then.

Haan kal hi aa jayega. Theek hai phir, r.text: Sunita says the paint will come tomorrow.
